clips.title: The story
paras: Abominable Creatures is a quest given by Captain Truman, a human loyalist desperately awaiting reinforcements on the outskirts of Lordaeron's fallen capital. Believing his commander—a revered Grand Marshal—is still valiantly fighting in the nearby Ruins of Lordaeron, Truman implores a capable adventurer to track him down. The mission exposes the grim fate of the kingdom's lost defenders and the bitter hostility smoldering among surviving loyalists.

Captain Truman stands vigilant at his post, anxiously awaiting long-overdue reinforcements to support the defense of Lordaeron. Confident in the martial prowess of his superior—a renowned Grand Marshal whom he describes as a tall, statuesque hero—Truman remains bound by duty after being commanded to hold the line while his commander charged into the ongoing fray. Harboring deep suspicion toward outsiders and openly scorning those he considers lesser breeds, the captain refuses to trust local irregulars. When a capable traveler approaches, Truman seizes the opportunity to enlist aid, pleading for someone to venture into the ruined territory to check on his master's well-being and assess the battle.

The search directs adventurers straight into the perilous Ruins of Lordaeron, the shattered capital that fell to the Scourge during the Third War. Although Captain Truman expects his glorious leader to be standing triumphant over the fallen, the reality within the blighted city is far grimmer. The ruins are overrun with horrors, undead remnants, and abominations wandering the broken stone plazas. Navigating these devastated streets requires confronting the brutal truth of what happened to the defenders who ventured into the city. Instead of finding an immaculate knight holding the line, travelers discover that the commander has met a tragic, twisted end among the monstrosities occupying the courtyards.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, a fellow traveler. It's about time Lordaeron sent reinforcements.
My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I don't dare trust this task to any of these filthy half breeds, but if I could impose on you a favor, I beg of you to find me the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Good to see you're still alive and kicking! How fares the battle? Have you seen my lord?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Truman looks at the head of his former lord in horror and disgust.
Is this... Some kind of joke? Why would you bring me this monstrosity's head?

Get out of my sight! I should have known better than to trust someone who allies themselves with the type of filth you do. The true sons of Lordaeron will reclaim our home. And when we do we'll finally be free to purge it of beasts and those who consort with them like you!
